LESSON: HANDLING WASTE MATERIALS

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 9
Subject: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
Strand: Materials
Topic 3.2: Handling waste materials
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 8

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Handling waste materials, part of Materials in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 9 PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES.

Key inquiry question: How can we reuse waste materials? 2. Why recycle waste materials to make items for day-to-day use?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Handling waste materials together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Self-Efficacy: effective communication skills are developed as the learner searches for information on safe ways of handling waste

materials in the environment

• Digital Literacy: learner develops digital skills when interacting and manipulating digital devices to search for information on safe ways

of handling waste materials in the environment.

Value:

• Responsibility: learner safely handles and disposes waste materials when making household items from waste materials.

•

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

• Internet Safety and Security: responsible online behaviour is enhanced as learner use digital or print resources to search for information on

safe ways of handling waste materials.

Link to other subjects

Creative Arts: learner enhances design skills when making items from recyclable waste materials.

Suggested Learning Resources:

• Digital devices like video.

• Local work places.

• Personal protective equipment (PPEs).

• Safety labels and manuals.

• Charts.
